[[File:NomisRobe-KOTOR2.jpg|thumb|Nomi's robe.]]
A '''[[Jedi apparel/Legends|robe]]''' said to have belonged to the legendary [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Nomi Sunrider]], this garment possibly fell into the possession of the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] during the [[First Jedi Purge]]. It imbued the wearer with greatly-increased wisdom and the ability to touch [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] more readily.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, only a character who is [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-sided]] can equip the robe.
